title: RMS CET Class 6 · 2022 Pattern Paper
description: RMS CET Class 6 paper on the 2022 pattern: 200 questions (English 50, Intelligence 50, Mathematics 50, General Knowledge 50), 150 minutes, 200 marks, 1 mark each, no negative marking. Original practice paper on the 2022 pattern (not the official paper). Free.

questions.text: Choose the word nearest in meaning to COURAGE.
questions.explanation: "Courage" and "bravery" both mean the quality of not being afraid.
questions.explanationHi: "courage" = साहस = "bravery"।

questions.text: Choose the word nearest in meaning to SILENT.
questions.explanation: "Silent" means making no sound, that is, quiet.
questions.explanationHi: "silent" = शांत = "quiet"।

questions.text: Choose the word nearest in meaning to DIFFICULT.
questions.explanation: "Difficult" means not easy, that is, hard.
questions.explanationHi: "difficult" = कठिन = "hard"।

questions.text: Choose the word nearest in meaning to GIFT.
questions.explanation: A gift is something given to someone, also called a present.
questions.explanationHi: "gift" = उपहार = "present"।

questions.text: Choose the word opposite in meaning to STRONG.
questions.explanation: The opposite of strong is weak; the other words mean strong.
questions.explanationHi: "strong" का विलोम "weak" है।

questions.text: Choose the word opposite in meaning to ACCEPT.
questions.explanation: To accept is to say yes and take something; to reject is to refuse it.
questions.explanationHi: "accept" (स्वीकार) का विलोम "reject" (अस्वीकार) है।

questions.text: Choose the word opposite in meaning to CRUEL.
questions.explanation: A cruel person causes pain; a kind person is gentle and caring.
questions.explanationHi: "cruel" (क्रूर) का विलोम "kind" (दयालु) है।

questions.text: Choose the word opposite in meaning to VISIBLE.
questions.explanation: Visible means can be seen; invisible means cannot be seen.
questions.explanationHi: "visible" (दिखाई देने वाला) का विलोम "invisible" है।

questions.text: Choose the word opposite in meaning to INCREASE.
questions.explanation: To increase is to become more; to decrease is to become less.
questions.explanationHi: "increase" (बढ़ना) का विलोम "decrease" (घटना) है।

questions.text: Fill in the blank with the correct article: She wants to become ___ engineer.
questions.explanation: "Engineer" begins with a vowel sound, so we use "an".
questions.explanationHi: "engineer" स्वर ध्वनि से शुरू होता है, इसलिए "an"।

questions.text: Fill in the blank with the correct article: ___ Himalayas are the highest mountains in the world.
questions.explanation: We use "the" before the names of mountain ranges.
questions.explanationHi: पर्वत-शृंखलाओं के नाम से पहले "the" लगता है।

questions.text: Fill in the blank: My uncle gave me ___ useful book.
questions.explanation: "Useful" begins with a "yoo" sound, which is a consonant sound, so we use "a".
questions.explanationHi: "useful" का उच्चारण "यूज़फुल" है (व्यंजन ध्वनि), इसलिए "a"।

questions.text: Fill in the blank: The bird is sitting ___ the branch.
questions.explanation: Something resting on the top of a surface is "on" it.
questions.explanationHi: डाल के ऊपर बैठी है = on।

questions.text: Fill in the blank: We have lived in this town ___ ten years.
questions.explanation: We use "for" with a period of time (ten years).
questions.explanationHi: समय की अवधि (ten years) के साथ "for" लगता है।

questions.text: Fill in the blank: The ball rolled ___ the table and fell on the floor.
questions.explanation: Moving away from the surface of the table is "off".
questions.explanationHi: मेज़ से नीचे गिरना = off।

questions.text: Fill in the blank: Divide the sweets ___ the two brothers.
questions.explanation: We use "between" for two people and "among" for more than two.
questions.explanationHi: दो के लिए "between", दो से अधिक के लिए "among"।

questions.text: Fill in the blank: She ___ her homework before her mother came home.
questions.explanation: Of two past actions, the earlier one takes the past perfect "had finished".
questions.explanationHi: भूतकाल में पहले हुए काम के लिए past perfect "had finished"।

questions.text: Fill in the blank: Listen! Someone ___ at the door.
questions.explanation: "Listen!" shows the action is happening now: present continuous "is knocking".
questions.explanationHi: "Listen!" = अभी हो रहा है, इसलिए "is knocking"।

questions.text: Fill in the blank: Water ___ at 100 degrees Celsius.
questions.explanation: A scientific fact is written in the simple present: "boils".
questions.explanationHi: वैज्ञानिक तथ्य के लिए simple present: "boils"।

questions.text: Fill in the blank: I ___ this film three times so far.
questions.explanation: "So far" goes with the present perfect "have seen".
questions.explanationHi: "so far" के साथ present perfect "have seen"।

questions.text: Choose the correct collective noun: a ___ of sheep.
questions.explanation: A group of sheep is called a flock.
questions.explanationHi: भेड़ों का समूह = flock।

questions.text: What is the plural of MOUSE?
questions.explanation: MOUSE has an irregular plural: mice.
questions.explanationHi: MOUSE का बहुवचन "mice" है।

questions.text: What is the feminine form of TIGER?
questions.explanation: The female of a tiger is a tigress.
questions.explanationHi: बाघिन = tigress।

questions.text: Fill in the blank with the correct pronoun: This book is ___; please give it to me.
questions.explanation: We need a possessive pronoun that stands alone: "mine".
questions.explanationHi: अकेले आने वाला स्वामित्व सर्वनाम "mine" है।

questions.text: Fill in the blank: Mount Everest is ___ than Kangchenjunga.
questions.explanation: Two things are compared, so we use the comparative "higher".
questions.explanationHi: दो की तुलना में comparative "higher"।

questions.text: One word for "a person who writes poems":
questions.explanation: A person who writes poems is a poet.
questions.explanationHi: कविता लिखने वाला = poet।

questions.text: One word for "a place where books are kept for people to read":
questions.explanation: Books are kept for reading in a library.
questions.explanationHi: पुस्तकालय = library।

questions.text: One word for "a person who offers to do work without being paid":
questions.explanation: Someone who works willingly without pay is a volunteer.
questions.explanationHi: बिना वेतन के स्वेच्छा से काम करने वाला = volunteer।

questions.text: One word for "animals that eat only plants":
questions.explanation: Plant-eating animals are herbivores.
questions.explanationHi: केवल पौधे खाने वाले = herbivores (शाकाहारी)।

questions.text: Choose the correctly spelt word.
questions.explanation: Remember "i before e, except after c": R-E-C-E-I-V-E.
questions.explanationHi: सही वर्तनी: receive।

questions.text: Which word is spelt correctly?
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is E-N-V-I-R-O-N-M-E-N-T.
questions.explanationHi: सही वर्तनी: environment।

questions.text: Pick the word with the correct spelling.
questions.explanation: The correct spelling is F-E-B-R-U-A-R-Y.

questions.text: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation: "Know" is not used in the continuous form; we say "I know".
questions.explanationHi: "know" का continuous रूप प्रयोग नहीं होता।

questions.text: Which sentence is grammatically correct?
questions.explanation: "News" is an uncountable noun and takes a singular verb: "is".
questions.explanationHi: "news" एकवचन माना जाता है, इसलिए "is"।

questions.text: Pick the sentence that has no error.
questions.explanation: "Well" is the adverb that describes how she sings.
questions.explanationHi: क्रिया "sings" की विशेषता क्रिया-विशेषण "well" बताता है।

questions.text: Choose the correct question for the answer: "They play football in the evening."
questions.explanation: With "they" we use "do" + base verb: "When do they play football?"
questions.explanationHi: "they" के साथ "do" आता है।

questions.text: Choose the correct question for the answer: "Meera has three brothers."
options: How many brothers does Meera has?
How much brothers does Meera have?
How many brothers does Meera have?
questions.explanation: For a number we ask "How many"; with "does" the verb becomes "have".
questions.explanationHi: गिनती के लिए "How many" और "does" के बाद "have"।

questions.text: The idiom "once in a blue moon" means
questions.explanation: "Once in a blue moon" means something that happens very rarely.
questions.explanationHi: बहुत कम, कभी-कभार।

questions.text: The idiom "to let the cat out of the bag" means
options: to tell a secret by mistake
questions.explanation: It means to reveal a secret, often by mistake.
questions.explanationHi: भेद खोल देना।

questions.text: Arrange the words to make a correct sentence: always / truth / speak / should / we / the
options: We should always speak the truth.
We always should the truth speak.
The truth should always speak we.
Speak we should the always truth.
questions.explanation: Subject (We) + helping verb (should) + adverb (always) + verb (speak) + object (the truth).
questions.explanationHi: कर्ता + सहायक क्रिया + क्रिया-विशेषण + क्रिया + कर्म।

questions.passage: The Siachen Glacier lies high in the Karakoram mountains in Ladakh. It is one of the longest glaciers outside the polar regions, about 76 kilometres long. Here the temperature can fall to fifty degrees below zero, and strong winds blow snow into the soldiers' faces. Indian soldiers have guarded this icy land since 1984. Their posts are so high that the air has less oxygen, and even walking a few steps feels tiring. The soldiers wear special white clothes, snow goggles and heavy boots. Food and fuel are often dropped by helicopters. Many brave men have given their lives here, not only in battle but also in avalanches and storms. When people call Siachen "the highest battlefield in the world", they also remember the courage of those who stand guard there every day.

questions.passage: Our school sports day was held on a bright February morning. The ground was decorated with coloured flags, and the school band played as the four houses marched past the stage. Our chief guest, a retired army officer, lit the sports torch and declared the games open. The first event was the 100-metre race. Simran of Class 5 ran so fast that she won by several metres. Then came the sack race, which made everyone laugh as children fell and rolled about. In the tug of war, Shivaji House pulled hard and defeated Tagore House. My little brother Kabir took part in the lemon-and-spoon race. He dropped his lemon twice, but he did not give up and finished the race. At the end, Shivaji House won the trophy. The chief guest told us that winning is good, but playing fair is even better.
questions.text: Who declared the games open?
questions.explanation: The chief guest, a retired army officer, "declared the games open".

questions.text: Bird : Nest :: Bee : ?

questions.text: Complete the analogy: 6 : 36 :: 9 : ?
questions.explanation: 36 is the square of 6 (6 × 6). The square of 9 is 81.
questions.explanationHi: 36, 6 का वर्ग है; 9 का वर्ग 81 है।

questions.text: Pen : Write :: Knife : ?
questions.textHi: कलम : लिखना :: चाकू : ?
questions.explanation: A pen is used to write; a knife is used to cut.
questions.explanationHi: कलम से लिखते हैं, चाकू से काटते हैं।

questions.text: Complete the analogy: ACE : BDF :: GIK : ?
questions.textHi: सादृश्य पूरा कीजिए: ACE : BDF :: GIK : ?
questions.explanation: Each letter moves one step forward: G→H, I→J, K→L.
questions.explanationHi: हर अक्षर एक आगे बढ़ता है: G→H, I→J, K→L।

questions.text: Complete the analogy: 8 : 4 :: 20 : ?
questions.explanation: 4 is half of 8, so the answer is half of 20 = 10.

questions.text: Find the odd one out: Rose, Lotus, Lily, Neem

questions.text: Find the odd one out: 11, 13, 17, 21
questions.explanation: 11, 13 and 17 are prime numbers; 21 = 3 × 7 is not prime.

questions.text: Find the odd one out: Car, Bus, Truck, Boat
questions.textHi: विषम को चुनिए: कार, बस, ट्रक, नाव
questions.explanation: Car, bus and truck run on roads; a boat moves on water.
questions.explanationHi: कार, बस, ट्रक सड़क पर चलते हैं; नाव पानी पर।

questions.text: Find the odd one out: ACE, BDF, GIK, LNQ
questions.textHi: विषम को चुनिए: ACE, BDF, GIK, LNQ

questions.text: Find the odd one out: Hockey, Cricket, Football, Chess

questions.explanation: Each number is doubled and 1 is added: 31 × 2 + 1 = 63.

questions.text: Find the next number: 1, 8, 27, 64, ?
questions.explanation: These are cubes: 1³, 2³, 3³, 4³, so next is 5³ = 125.
questions.explanationHi: ये घन संख्याएँ हैं; अगली 5³ = 125।

questions.text: Find the next number: 2, 5, 10, 17, 26, ?
questions.explanation: Differences are 3, 5, 7, 9, so next is 11: 26 + 11 = 37.

questions.text: Find the next number: 81, 27, 9, 3, ?
questions.explanation: Each number is divided by 3: 3 ÷ 3 = 1.
questions.explanationHi: हर संख्या को 3 से भाग देते हैं: 3 ÷ 3 = 1।

questions.text: Find the next letter: B, E, H, K, ?
questions.textHi: अगला अक्षर ज्ञात कीजिए: B, E, H, K, ?
questions.explanation: Each letter is 3 steps ahead: K + 3 = N.
questions.explanationHi: हर अक्षर 3 कदम आगे है: K + 3 = N।

questions.text: Find the next letter: Y, W, U, S, ?
questions.textHi: अगला अक्षर ज्ञात कीजिए: Y, W, U, S, ?
questions.explanation: We go back 2 letters each time: S, (R), Q.
questions.explanationHi: हर बार 2 अक्षर पीछे: S, (R), Q।

questions.text: Find the next term: AZ, BY, CX, ?

questions.explanationHi: पहला अक्षर आगे (A, B, C, D) और दूसरा पीछे (Z, Y, X, W) जाता है।

questions.explanationHi: पूजा, गोपाल के बेटे की बेटी है, अतः पोती।

questions.text: Introducing a man, Neha said, "He is the only son of my mother." How is the man related to Neha?
questions.textHi: एक व्यक्ति का परिचय देते हुए नेहा ने कहा, "वह मेरी माँ का इकलौता बेटा है।" वह व्यक्ति नेहा का क्या लगता है?
questions.explanation: The son of Neha's mother is Neha's brother.
questions.explanationHi: नेहा की माँ का बेटा नेहा का भाई है।

questions.text: X and Y are sisters. Z is the son of Y. How is X related to Z?
questions.textHi: X और Y बहनें हैं। Z, Y का बेटा है। X का Z से क्या संबंध है?
questions.explanation: X is the sister of Z's mother, so she is Z's aunt (mausi).
questions.explanationHi: X, Z की माँ की बहन है, अतः मौसी।

questions.text: Arun walks 6 km towards the south, then turns left and walks 2 km. Which direction is he facing now?
questions.textHi: अरुण 6 km दक्षिण की ओर चलता है, फिर बाएँ मुड़कर 2 km चलता है। अब उसका मुख किस दिशा में है?
questions.explanation: When you face south, your left hand is towards the east.
questions.explanationHi: दक्षिण की ओर मुख होने पर बायाँ हाथ पूर्व की ओर होता है।

questions.text: Asha walks 10 m east, turns left and walks 5 m, then turns left again and walks 10 m. Where is she now from her starting point?
questions.textHi: आशा 10 m पूर्व चलती है, बाएँ मुड़कर 5 m चलती है, फिर दोबारा बाएँ मुड़कर 10 m चलती है। अब वह आरंभिक स्थान से कहाँ है?
questions.explanation: East 10 m, then north 5 m, then west 10 m brings her back above the start: 5 m north.
questions.explanationHi: पूर्व 10 m, उत्तर 5 m, फिर पश्चिम 10 m; वह आरंभ से 5 m उत्तर में है।

questions.text: In the morning, Raju stands facing the rising sun. In which direction will his shadow fall?
questions.textHi: सुबह राजू उगते सूरज की ओर मुख करके खड़ा है। उसकी परछाईं किस दिशा में पड़ेगी?
questions.explanation: The sun rises in the east, so the shadow falls behind him, towards the west.
questions.explanationHi: सूरज पूर्व में उगता है, इसलिए परछाईं पीछे, यानी पश्चिम में पड़ती है।

questions.text: A girl is facing east. She turns 90° anticlockwise. Which direction is she facing now?
questions.textHi: एक लड़की का मुख पूर्व की ओर है। वह 90° वामावर्त (घड़ी की उल्टी दिशा में) घूमती है। अब उसका मुख किस ओर है?
questions.explanation: Anticlockwise order is East → North → West → South. After east comes north.
questions.explanationHi: वामावर्त क्रम: पूर्व → उत्तर → पश्चिम → दक्षिण।

questions.text: In a row of 30 boys, Aman is 12th from the right end. What is his position from the left end?
questions.textHi: 30 लड़कों की पंक्ति में अमन दाएँ छोर से 12वाँ है। बाएँ छोर से उसका स्थान क्या है?
questions.explanation: Position from left = 30 − 12 + 1 = 19.

questions.text: A is heavier than B. B is heavier than C. D is heavier than A. Who is the lightest?
questions.textHi: A, B से भारी है। B, C से भारी है। D, A से भारी है। सबसे हल्का कौन है?
questions.explanation: Order: D > A > B > C, so C is the lightest.
questions.explanationHi: क्रम: D > A > B > C; अतः C सबसे हल्का।

questions.text: Neeraj is 7th from the top and 26th from the bottom in his class. How many students are in the class?
questions.textHi: नीरज अपनी कक्षा में ऊपर से 7वाँ और नीचे से 26वाँ है। कक्षा में कितने विद्यार्थी हैं?

questions.text: 15 August 2022 was a Monday. Which day was 20 August 2022?
questions.textHi: 15 अगस्त 2022 को सोमवार था। 20 अगस्त 2022 को कौन-सा दिन था?
questions.explanation: 5 days after Monday: Tue, Wed, Thu, Fri, Sat. So it was Saturday.
questions.explanationHi: सोमवार के 5 दिन बाद: मंगल, बुध, गुरु, शुक्र, शनि; अतः शनिवार।

questions.text: What is the angle between the hands of a clock at 6 o'clock?
questions.textHi: 6 बजे घड़ी की सुइयों के बीच कितना कोण होता है?
questions.explanation: At 6:00 the hands point in opposite directions: 6 × 30° = 180°.

questions.text: Which of these years is a leap year?
questions.textHi: इनमें से कौन-सा वर्ष लीप वर्ष है?
questions.explanation: 2020 is divisible by 4, so it is a leap year with 366 days.
questions.explanationHi: 2020, 4 से विभाज्य है, अतः लीप वर्ष है।

questions.text: If '×' means '+', '+' means '−' and '−' means '×', then 8 × 4 − 2 + 5 = ?
questions.explanation: Change the signs: 8 + 4 × 2 − 5 = 8 + 8 − 5 = 11.

questions.text: Find the missing number. Row 1: 8, 3, 24; Row 2: 6, 5, 30; Row 3: 9, 4, ?
questions.explanation: The third number is the product of the first two: 9 × 4 = 36.
questions.explanationHi: तीसरी संख्या पहली दो का गुणनफल है: 9 × 4 = 36।

questions.text: In a group of 40 children, 25 like football and 20 like cricket. Every child likes at least one of the two games. How many like both?
questions.textHi: 40 बच्चों के समूह में 25 को फ़ुटबॉल और 20 को क्रिकेट पसंद है। हर बच्चा कम से कम एक खेल पसंद करता है। कितने बच्चे दोनों पसंद करते हैं?
questions.explanation: 25 + 20 = 45, but there are only 40 children, so 45 − 40 = 5 are counted twice (they like both).
questions.explanationHi: 25 + 20 = 45, बच्चे केवल 40 हैं; अतः 5 बच्चे दोनों पसंद करते हैं।

questions.text: Which capital letter looks exactly the same in its water image (reflection in water below it)?
questions.textHi: कौन-सा बड़ा अक्षर पानी में अपने प्रतिबिंब (जल प्रतिबिंब) में बिल्कुल वैसा ही दिखता है?
questions.explanation: In a water image top and bottom are swapped. E has the same top and bottom halves, so it looks unchanged.
questions.explanationHi: जल प्रतिबिंब में ऊपर-नीचे बदल जाता है। E के ऊपरी और निचले भाग समान हैं।

questions.textHi: मान ज्ञात कीजिए: 4.25 kg − 1.8 kg = ?

questions.text: The perimeter of a square is 56 cm. What is the length of its side?
questions.textHi: एक वर्ग का परिमाप 56 cm है। उसकी भुजा कितनी है?
questions.explanation: Side = perimeter ÷ 4 = 56 ÷ 4 = 14 cm.

questions.text: What is the area of a rectangular parking ground 25 m long and 12 m wide?
questions.textHi: 25 m लंबे और 12 m चौड़े आयताकार पार्किंग मैदान का क्षेत्रफल क्या है?
questions.explanationHi: क्षेत्रफल = 25 × 12 = 300 वर्ग m।

questions.text: A field is 40 m long and 30 m wide. What is the cost of fencing it at ₹15 per metre?
questions.textHi: एक खेत 40 m लंबा और 30 m चौड़ा है। ₹15 प्रति मीटर की दर से उसकी बाड़ लगाने का खर्च कितना होगा?

questions.text: What is the complement of 35°?
questions.textHi: 35° का पूरक कोण क्या है?
questions.explanation: Complementary angles add up to 90°: 90 − 35 = 55°.

questions.text: Each angle of an equilateral triangle measures
questions.textHi: समबाहु त्रिभुज का प्रत्येक कोण कितना होता है?
questions.explanation: All three angles are equal and add to 180°: 180 ÷ 3 = 60°.

questions.text: How many minutes are there from 10:50 a.m. to 1:10 p.m.?
questions.textHi: सुबह 10:50 से दोपहर 1:10 तक कितने मिनट होते हैं?
questions.explanation: 10:50 to 12:50 is 2 hours (120 min); 12:50 to 1:10 is 20 min. Total 140 minutes.

questions.text: 26 January 2022 was a Wednesday. Which day was 31 January 2022?
questions.textHi: 26 जनवरी 2022 को बुधवार था। 31 जनवरी 2022 को कौन-सा दिन था?
questions.explanation: 5 days after Wednesday: Thu, Fri, Sat, Sun, Mon. So it was Monday.
questions.explanationHi: बुधवार के 5 दिन बाद: गुरु, शुक्र, शनि, रवि, सोम; अतः सोमवार।

questions.text: A family drove on a four-day trip: Day 1 – 120 km, Day 2 – 85 km, Day 3 – 150 km, Day 4 – 95 km. What was the total distance travelled?
questions.textHi: एक परिवार ने चार दिन की कार यात्रा की: पहला दिन – 120 km, दूसरा दिन – 85 km, तीसरा दिन – 150 km, चौथा दिन – 95 km। कुल कितनी दूरी तय की गई?

questions.text: A family drove on a four-day trip: Day 1 – 120 km, Day 2 – 85 km, Day 3 – 150 km, Day 4 – 95 km. What was the average distance travelled per day?
questions.textHi: एक परिवार ने चार दिन की कार यात्रा की: पहला दिन – 120 km, दूसरा दिन – 85 km, तीसरा दिन – 150 km, चौथा दिन – 95 km। प्रतिदिन औसतन कितनी दूरी तय की गई?
questions.explanation: Average = 450 ÷ 4 = 112.5 km.

questions.text: How many minutes make 2/5 of an hour?
questions.textHi: एक घंटे के 2/5 भाग में कितने मिनट होते हैं?
questions.explanation: 1/5 of 60 minutes = 12 minutes, so 2/5 = 24 minutes.

questions.text: How many prime numbers are there between 1 and 20?
questions.textHi: 1 और 20 के बीच कितनी अभाज्य संख्याएँ हैं?
questions.explanation: They are 2, 3, 5, 7, 11, 13, 17 and 19: eight numbers.

questions.text: A plane leaves Delhi at 11:20 and the flight takes 2 hours 55 minutes. At what time does it land?
questions.textHi: एक विमान दिल्ली से 11:20 बजे उड़ता है और उड़ान में 2 घंटे 55 मिनट लगते हैं। वह कितने बजे उतरेगा?

questions.text: Two cars start from the same place at the same time and go in opposite directions at 40 km/h and 50 km/h. How far apart will they be after 3 hours?
questions.textHi: दो कारें एक ही स्थान से एक साथ विपरीत दिशाओं में 40 km/h और 50 km/h की चाल से चलती हैं। 3 घंटे बाद उनके बीच कितनी दूरी होगी?
questions.explanation: Each hour they move 40 + 50 = 90 km apart. In 3 hours: 90 × 3 = 270 km.
questions.explanationHi: हर घंटे 90 km दूर होती हैं; 3 घंटे में 270 km।

questions.text: 4,986 rounded off to the nearest thousand is
questions.textHi: 4,986 को निकटतम हज़ार में पूर्णांकित करने पर मिलता है:
questions.explanation: The hundreds digit is 9 (5 or more), so we round up to 5,000.

questions.text: The Constitution of India came into force on
questions.textHi: भारत का संविधान कब लागू हुआ?
questions.explanation: It came into force on 26 January 1950, celebrated every year as Republic Day.
questions.explanationHi: संविधान 26 जनवरी 1950 को लागू हुआ; इसे गणतंत्र दिवस के रूप में मनाते हैं।

questions.text: Who was the Chairman of the Drafting Committee of the Indian Constitution?
questions.textHi: भारतीय संविधान की प्रारूप (ड्राफ़्टिंग) समिति के अध्यक्ष कौन थे?
questions.explanation: Dr B. R. Ambedkar headed the Drafting Committee and is called the chief architect of the Constitution.
questions.explanationHi: डॉ. आंबेडकर प्रारूप समिति के अध्यक्ष थे; उन्हें संविधान का मुख्य शिल्पकार कहा जाता है।

questions.text: Constitution Day (Samvidhan Divas) is celebrated in India on
questions.textHi: भारत में संविधान दिवस कब मनाया जाता है?
questions.explanation: The Constitution was adopted on 26 November 1949, so Constitution Day is 26 November.
questions.explanationHi: संविधान 26 नवंबर 1949 को अपनाया गया, इसलिए संविधान दिवस 26 नवंबर को है।

questions.text: Who was the first President of India?
questions.textHi: भारत के पहले राष्ट्रपति कौन थे?
questions.explanation: Dr Rajendra Prasad was the first President of India (1950–1962).
questions.explanationHi: डॉ. राजेंद्र प्रसाद भारत के पहले राष्ट्रपति थे।

questions.text: The introduction to the Constitution of India, which begins with "We, the people of India", is called the
questions.textHi: भारतीय संविधान का परिचय, जो "हम, भारत के लोग" से शुरू होता है, क्या कहलाता है?
questions.explanation: The Preamble is the introduction to the Constitution.
questions.explanationHi: संविधान के परिचय को प्रस्तावना (उद्देशिका) कहते हैं।

questions.text: What is the minimum age for voting in elections in India?
questions.textHi: भारत में चुनाव में मतदान की न्यूनतम आयु क्या है?
questions.explanation: Every citizen aged 18 years or more can vote.
questions.explanationHi: 18 वर्ष या उससे अधिक आयु का हर नागरिक मतदान कर सकता है।

questions.text: Which is the lower house of the Parliament of India?
questions.textHi: भारतीय संसद का निचला सदन कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: Parliament has two houses: Lok Sabha (lower house) and Rajya Sabha (upper house).
questions.explanationHi: संसद के दो सदन हैं: लोकसभा (निचला) और राज्यसभा (उच्च)।

questions.text: How many Fundamental Duties are there in the Constitution of India?
questions.textHi: भारतीय संविधान में कितने मौलिक कर्तव्य हैं?
questions.explanation: There are 11 Fundamental Duties, such as respecting the National Flag and protecting the environment.
questions.explanationHi: संविधान में 11 मौलिक कर्तव्य हैं।

questions.text: Who is the constitutional head of a state in India?
questions.textHi: भारत में किसी राज्य का संवैधानिक प्रमुख कौन होता है?
questions.explanation: The Governor is the constitutional head of a state; the Chief Minister heads the state government.
questions.explanationHi: राज्यपाल राज्य के संवैधानिक प्रमुख हैं; मुख्यमंत्री सरकार के प्रमुख।

questions.text: Jim Corbett National Park, the oldest national park of India, is in which state?
questions.textHi: भारत का सबसे पुराना राष्ट्रीय उद्यान जिम कॉर्बेट किस राज्य में है?
questions.explanation: Set up in 1936, Jim Corbett National Park is in Uttarakhand.
questions.explanationHi: 1936 में बना जिम कॉर्बेट राष्ट्रीय उद्यान उत्तराखंड में है।

questions.text: Kaziranga National Park in Assam is famous for
questions.textHi: असम का काज़ीरंगा राष्ट्रीय उद्यान किसके लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
questions.explanation: Kaziranga is home to most of the world's one-horned rhinoceroses.
questions.explanationHi: काज़ीरंगा एक सींग वाले गैंडों के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।

questions.text: Gir National Park in Gujarat is the only home in the wild of the
questions.textHi: गुजरात का गिर राष्ट्रीय उद्यान किसका एकमात्र प्राकृतिक घर है?
questions.explanation: Asiatic lions live in the wild only in and around Gir in Gujarat.
questions.explanationHi: एशियाई शेर जंगल में केवल गिर (गुजरात) में पाए जाते हैं।

questions.text: The Sundarbans National Park in West Bengal is famous for the
questions.textHi: पश्चिम बंगाल का सुंदरबन राष्ट्रीय उद्यान किसके लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
questions.explanation: The mangrove forests of the Sundarbans are famous for the Royal Bengal tiger.
questions.explanationHi: सुंदरबन के मैंग्रोव वन रॉयल बंगाल टाइगर के लिए प्रसिद्ध हैं।

questions.text: Keoladeo National Park at Bharatpur, Rajasthan, is famous for
questions.textHi: भरतपुर (राजस्थान) का केवलादेव राष्ट्रीय उद्यान किसके लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
questions.explanation: Keoladeo (Bharatpur Bird Sanctuary) is visited by thousands of birds every winter.
questions.explanationHi: केवलादेव में हर सर्दी हज़ारों पक्षी आते हैं।

questions.text: Hemis National Park in Ladakh is well known for the
questions.textHi: लद्दाख का हेमिस राष्ट्रीय उद्यान किसके लिए प्रसिद्ध है?
questions.explanation: Hemis, high in the cold mountains of Ladakh, is famous for snow leopards.
questions.explanationHi: हेमिस हिम तेंदुओं के लिए प्रसिद्ध है।

questions.text: Periyar National Park (Periyar Tiger Reserve) is in which state?
questions.textHi: पेरियार राष्ट्रीय उद्यान (पेरियार टाइगर रिज़र्व) किस राज्य में है?
questions.explanation: Periyar is in Kerala, near the hill town of Thekkady.
questions.explanationHi: पेरियार केरल में थेक्कडी के पास है।

questions.text: Dachigam National Park in Jammu and Kashmir is known for which animal?
questions.textHi: जम्मू-कश्मीर का दाचीगाम राष्ट्रीय उद्यान किस जानवर के लिए जाना जाता है?
questions.explanation: Dachigam near Srinagar protects the hangul, the Kashmir stag.
questions.explanationHi: दाचीगाम (श्रीनगर के पास) हंगुल का घर है।

questions.text: In September 2022, cheetahs brought from Namibia were released in which national park of India?
questions.textHi: सितंबर 2022 में नामीबिया से लाए गए चीते भारत के किस राष्ट्रीय उद्यान में छोड़े गए?
questions.explanation: On 17 September 2022, eight cheetahs from Namibia were released in Kuno National Park, Madhya Pradesh.
questions.explanationHi: 17 सितंबर 2022 को नामीबिया से आए आठ चीते मध्य प्रदेश के कूनो राष्ट्रीय उद्यान में छोड़े गए।

questions.text: What was the name of India's first satellite, launched in 1975?
questions.textHi: 1975 में छोड़े गए भारत के पहले उपग्रह का नाम क्या था?
questions.explanation: India's first satellite, Aryabhata, was launched in 1975 and named after the ancient mathematician.
questions.explanationHi: भारत का पहला उपग्रह आर्यभट 1975 में छोड़ा गया।

questions.text: Who was the first Indian to travel into space, in 1984?
questions.textHi: 1984 में अंतरिक्ष में जाने वाले पहले भारतीय कौन थे?
questions.explanation: Squadron Leader Rakesh Sharma of the Indian Air Force went to space in 1984.
questions.explanationHi: भारतीय वायुसेना के स्क्वाड्रन लीडर राकेश शर्मा 1984 में अंतरिक्ष गए।

questions.text: Where is the headquarters of ISRO (Indian Space Research Organisation)?
questions.textHi: इसरो (भारतीय अंतरिक्ष अनुसंधान संगठन) का मुख्यालय कहाँ है?
questions.explanation: ISRO has its headquarters in Bengaluru, Karnataka.
questions.explanationHi: इसरो का मुख्यालय बेंगलुरु (कर्नाटक) में है।

questions.text: India's main rocket launch centre, the Satish Dhawan Space Centre, is at
questions.textHi: भारत का मुख्य रॉकेट प्रक्षेपण केंद्र, सतीश धवन अंतरिक्ष केंद्र, कहाँ है?
questions.explanation: It is on Sriharikota island in Andhra Pradesh.
questions.explanationHi: यह आंध्र प्रदेश के श्रीहरिकोटा द्वीप पर है।

questions.text: Who is called the "Father of the Indian Space Programme"?
questions.textHi: "भारतीय अंतरिक्ष कार्यक्रम का जनक" किसे कहा जाता है?
questions.explanation: Dr Vikram Sarabhai started India's space programme and helped set up ISRO.
questions.explanationHi: डॉ. विक्रम साराभाई ने भारत का अंतरिक्ष कार्यक्रम शुरू किया।

questions.text: India's Mars Orbiter Mission, which reached Mars orbit in 2014, is popularly called
questions.textHi: भारत का मंगल कक्षित्र मिशन, जो 2014 में मंगल की कक्षा में पहुँचा, किस नाम से प्रसिद्ध है?
questions.explanation: Mangalyaan reached Mars orbit in September 2014 in its very first attempt.
questions.explanationHi: मंगलयान सितंबर 2014 में पहले ही प्रयास में मंगल की कक्षा में पहुँचा।

questions.text: In 2008, India's Chandrayaan-1 mission helped find evidence of what on the Moon?
questions.textHi: 2008 के भारत के चंद्रयान-1 मिशन ने चंद्रमा पर किसके प्रमाण खोजने में मदद की?
questions.explanation: Chandrayaan-1, launched in 2008, helped discover signs of water on the Moon.
questions.explanationHi: 2008 में छोड़े गए चंद्रयान-1 ने चंद्रमा पर पानी के संकेत खोजने में मदद की।

questions.text: Who was the first woman of Indian origin to go into space?
questions.textHi: अंतरिक्ष में जाने वाली भारतीय मूल की पहली महिला कौन थीं?
questions.explanation: Kalpana Chawla, born in Karnal, Haryana, first flew into space in 1997.
questions.explanationHi: करनाल (हरियाणा) में जन्मी कल्पना चावला 1997 में अंतरिक्ष गईं।

questions.text: Which is the star nearest to the Earth?
questions.textHi: पृथ्वी के सबसे निकट का तारा कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: The Sun is a star, and it is the nearest star to the Earth. The Moon is not a star.
questions.explanationHi: सूर्य एक तारा है और पृथ्वी के सबसे निकट है; चंद्रमा तारा नहीं है।

questions.text: The Indian Military Academy (IMA), which trains Army officers, is located at
questions.textHi: सेना अधिकारियों को प्रशिक्षण देने वाली भारतीय सैन्य अकादमी (IMA) कहाँ है?
questions.explanation: The IMA is at Dehradun, Uttarakhand.
questions.explanationHi: IMA देहरादून (उत्तराखंड) में है।

questions.text: Indian Air Force Day is celebrated every year on
questions.textHi: भारतीय वायुसेना दिवस हर वर्ष कब मनाया जाता है?
questions.explanation: Air Force Day is on 8 October. (26 July is Kargil Vijay Diwas.)
questions.explanationHi: वायुसेना दिवस 8 अक्टूबर को है।

questions.text: Which is India's highest gallantry award in peacetime?
questions.textHi: शांतिकाल में भारत का सर्वोच्च वीरता पुरस्कार कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: The Ashoka Chakra is the highest peacetime gallantry award.
questions.explanationHi: अशोक चक्र शांतिकाल का सर्वोच्च वीरता पुरस्कार है।

questions.text: The rank of Captain in the Army is equal to which rank in the Navy?
questions.textHi: थल सेना का कैप्टन पद नौसेना के किस पद के बराबर है?
questions.explanation: Army Captain = Navy Lieutenant = Air Force Flight Lieutenant.
questions.explanationHi: थल सेना कैप्टन = नौसेना लेफ़्टिनेंट = वायुसेना फ़्लाइट लेफ़्टिनेंट।

questions.text: "Yudh Abhyas" is a joint military exercise between India and
questions.textHi: "युद्ध अभ्यास" भारत और किस देश के बीच संयुक्त सैन्य अभ्यास है?
questions.explanation: Yudh Abhyas is held between the armies of India and the USA.
questions.explanationHi: युद्ध अभ्यास भारत और अमेरिका की सेनाओं के बीच होता है।

questions.text: What is the national aquatic animal of India?
questions.textHi: भारत का राष्ट्रीय जलीय जीव कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: The Gangetic river dolphin was declared the national aquatic animal in 2009.
questions.explanationHi: गंगा नदी डॉल्फ़िन को 2009 में राष्ट्रीय जलीय जीव घोषित किया गया।

questions.text: What is the national tree of India?
questions.textHi: भारत का राष्ट्रीय वृक्ष कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: The banyan tree is the national tree of India.
questions.explanationHi: बरगद भारत का राष्ट्रीय वृक्ष है।

questions.text: The National Emblem of India is taken from the Lion Capital of Ashoka at
questions.textHi: भारत का राष्ट्रीय प्रतीक अशोक के सिंह स्तंभ से लिया गया है, जो कहाँ है?
questions.explanation: The emblem comes from the Lion Capital found at Sarnath, near Varanasi.
questions.explanationHi: राष्ट्रीय प्रतीक सारनाथ (वाराणसी के पास) के सिंह शीर्ष से लिया गया है।

questions.text: What is the capital of Arunachal Pradesh?
questions.textHi: अरुणाचल प्रदेश की राजधानी क्या है?
questions.explanation: Itanagar is the capital of Arunachal Pradesh.
questions.explanationHi: अरुणाचल प्रदेश की राजधानी ईटानगर है।

questions.text: Which is the largest planet of our solar system?
questions.textHi: हमारे सौरमंडल का सबसे बड़ा ग्रह कौन-सा है?
questions.explanation: Jupiter is the largest planet.
questions.explanationHi: बृहस्पति सबसे बड़ा ग्रह है।

questions.text: Which organ of our body pumps blood to all parts?
questions.textHi: हमारे शरीर का कौन-सा अंग पूरे शरीर में रक्त पंप करता है?
questions.explanation: The heart pumps blood through the blood vessels.
questions.explanationHi: हृदय रक्त को पूरे शरीर में पंप करता है।

questions.text: The ozone layer protects us from the harmful
questions.textHi: ओज़ोन परत हमें किन हानिकारक किरणों से बचाती है?
questions.explanation: The ozone layer high in the sky absorbs most of the Sun's harmful ultraviolet (UV) rays.
questions.explanationHi: ओज़ोन परत सूर्य की अधिकतर पराबैंगनी (UV) किरणों को सोख लेती है।

questions.text: World Environment Day is observed every year on
questions.textHi: विश्व पर्यावरण दिवस हर वर्ष कब मनाया जाता है?
questions.explanation: World Environment Day is on 5 June. (22 April is Earth Day; 21 June is Yoga Day.)
questions.explanationHi: विश्व पर्यावरण दिवस 5 जून को है।

questions.text: Who wrote "Gitanjali", for which he won the Nobel Prize in Literature in 1913?
questions.textHi: "गीतांजलि" किसने लिखी, जिसके लिए उन्हें 1913 में साहित्य का नोबेल पुरस्कार मिला?
questions.explanation: Rabindranath Tagore wrote "Gitanjali" and became the first Asian Nobel laureate in 1913.
questions.explanationHi: रवींद्रनाथ टैगोर ने "गीतांजलि" लिखी और 1913 में नोबेल पाने वाले पहले एशियाई बने।

questions.text: How many players of one team are on the field in a hockey match?
questions.textHi: हॉकी मैच में एक टीम के कितने खिलाड़ी मैदान पर होते हैं?
questions.explanation: A hockey team has 11 players on the field, including the goalkeeper.
questions.explanationHi: हॉकी में गोलकीपर सहित 11 खिलाड़ी मैदान पर होते हैं।

questions.text: The Durand Cup is associated with which sport?
questions.textHi: डूरंड कप किस खेल से संबंधित है?
questions.explanation: The Durand Cup, started in 1888, is one of the oldest football tournaments in the world.
questions.explanationHi: 1888 में शुरू हुआ डूरंड कप विश्व की सबसे पुरानी फ़ुटबॉल प्रतियोगिताओं में से है।

questions.text: In July 2022, who became the 15th President of India?
questions.textHi: जुलाई 2022 में भारत की 15वीं राष्ट्रपति कौन बनीं?
questions.explanation: Droupadi Murmu took oath as the 15th President of India on 25 July 2022.
questions.explanationHi: द्रौपदी मुर्मु ने 25 जुलाई 2022 को 15वीं राष्ट्रपति के रूप में शपथ ली।

questions.text: In September 2022, India's first indigenously built aircraft carrier was commissioned. What is its name?
questions.textHi: सितंबर 2022 में भारत में बना पहला स्वदेशी विमानवाहक पोत नौसेना में शामिल हुआ। उसका नाम क्या है?
questions.explanation: INS Vikrant was commissioned into the Indian Navy on 2 September 2022.
questions.explanationHi: INS विक्रांत 2 सितंबर 2022 को नौसेना में शामिल हुआ।

questions.text: In 2022, the 44th Chess Olympiad was held in India in which state?
questions.textHi: 2022 में 44वाँ शतरंज ओलंपियाड भारत के किस राज्य में हुआ?
questions.explanation: The 44th Chess Olympiad was held at Mamallapuram near Chennai, Tamil Nadu, in 2022.
questions.explanationHi: 2022 में 44वाँ शतरंज ओलंपियाड चेन्नई के पास मामल्लपुरम (तमिलनाडु) में हुआ।

questions.text: In 2022, India won the Thomas Cup for the first time. The Thomas Cup is related to
questions.textHi: 2022 में भारत ने पहली बार थॉमस कप जीता। थॉमस कप किस खेल से संबंधित है?
questions.explanation: The Thomas Cup is the world men's team championship in badminton. India won it in May 2022.
questions.explanationHi: थॉमस कप बैडमिंटन की पुरुष टीम प्रतियोगिता है; भारत ने मई 2022 में इसे जीता।

questions.text: In 2022, Rajpath in New Delhi was renamed as
questions.textHi: 2022 में नई दिल्ली के राजपथ का नाम बदलकर क्या रखा गया?
questions.explanation: In September 2022, Rajpath was renamed Kartavya Path.
questions.explanationHi: सितंबर 2022 में राजपथ का नाम कर्तव्य पथ रखा गया।

questions.text: Which country won the FIFA Football World Cup held in Qatar in 2022?
questions.textHi: कतर में 2022 में हुआ फ़ीफ़ा फ़ुटबॉल विश्व कप किस देश ने जीता?
questions.explanation: Argentina beat France in the final in December 2022.
questions.explanationHi: दिसंबर 2022 के फ़ाइनल में अर्जेंटीना ने फ़्रांस को हराया।

questions.text: In 2022, the Commonwealth Games were held in which city?
questions.textHi: 2022 में राष्ट्रमंडल खेल किस शहर में हुए?
questions.explanation: The 2022 Commonwealth Games were held in Birmingham, England.
questions.explanationHi: 2022 के राष्ट्रमंडल खेल बर्मिंघम (इंग्लैंड) में हुए।
